meta.title: A surrogate-bid reference note without a files list crashes after the bid is saved
gaps: The surrogate_bid operation does not expose surrogate_remarks.remarks or the ability to omit attachments, so the reference note without a files list is not directly tested.
The plan cannot distinguish an accepted response from a valid 422 refusal.
it does not read the record back to confirm what was kept or shown

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer enters a bid on a vendor's behalf (surrogate bid) for the invited QA vendor.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
